928033.description:
The 'Mean' Delamain variant encountered as part of [Epistrophy: Coastview](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928032) is voiced by Ellen McLain, the actress behind the Portal' series own rogue AI, GLaDOS. 

Several of GLaDOS' iconic lines are referenced word-for-word, including:
- Well, you found me. Congratulations. Was it worth it?
- Your specimen has been processed and we are now ready to begin the test proper.
- I'm going to kill you, and all the cake is gone.
- You chose this path. Now I have a surprise for you. Deploying surprise in Five. Four.
- I let you survive this long because I was curious about your behavior. Well, you've managed to destroy that part of me.
- A bitter, unlikable loner whose passing shall not be mourned.
- What's your point, anyway? Survival?
- You're still shuffling around a little, but believe me you're dead.
- The talking is over.

928040.description: The vehicle featured in [I'm in Love with My Car](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928038), styled with the name "Hoon" and number 43, are references to rally driver Ken Block.

928871.description:
As part of the [Big in Japan](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=928850) side job, you'll drop a man off here. Asking what his deal is prompts this response:

_"In Japan, brain surgeon, top of all. Good instinct. One day, Tyger Claw boss need surgery. But, boss die on the table! Tyger Claws were very angry. I hide in boat, swim to America. Here Dennis save me. But there is secret - I kill Tyger Claw boss on purpose. World best surgeon make no mistake!"_

It's referencing a well-known gag from Season 6 episode 21 of The Office (US).

929060.description:
The bodies found here, along with [Archived Conversation: Albert Cole and Gary Epps](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929059) shard, are references to the Fallout series.

Albert Cole is one of three pre-made characters in the first Fallout, and the LARP scenario he describes about finding a hydroprocessor before the bunker dwellers run out of fresh water parallels the hunt for a water chip.

Gary Epps' name may be a reference to GURPS, a roleplaying system that Fallout used before legal squabbles necessitated the creation of S.P.E.C.I.A.L; Fallout was originally going to be named _Fallout: A GURPS Post-Nuclear Adventure._

Also, Bunker 101 is of course a reference to Vault 101 from Fallout 3.

929070.description:
The bodies surrounding the fuel truck, and [nearby shard](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929069), are references to the 2015 film Mad Max: Fury Road.

The body near the shard has face paint bearing a striking resemblance to Furiosa, the character played by Charlize Theron; 'Charlize Fury' is a merging of the actress and characters' names.

In the film, a fuel rig much like the one here is used to transport pregnant women. The shard on the ground mentions a similar situation, with one of the crew being Max - presumably a rather mad fella.

There's also a large Biotechnica guard nearby with a half-removed mask; likely a reference to the film's main antagonist, Immortan Joe.

929075.description: The RV in this spot has five bullet holes in its door, referencing the state of the RV from Breaking Bad.

929093.description:
The bodies and [shard](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=929092) found here are references to the 1994 film Pulp Fiction.
- 'Marsellus Wayans' is a nod to Marsellus Wallace
- 'Vincent Vack' is a nod to Vincent Vega; one body is wearing a suit, just like the film character
- The 'Butch' they mention is a nod to Butch Coolidge
- The fatal boxing match is also a major part of the film's plot
- The katana on the ground is a weapon used by Butch

930385.description: The man with a malfunctioning shlong encountered as part of [Burning Desire](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=606255) uses the face and voice of content creator Jesse Cox.

934367.description:
When visiting the oil fields during [Chippin' In](https://mapgenie.io/cyberpunk-2077/maps/night-city?locationIds=933128), a secret ending can be unlocked later in the game if you choose these dialogue options after Johnny mentions managing "not to fuck this up, what we have."
- Nah, fucked that up too.
- What do you want from me?
- Ok. But as second chances go, this is your last.
